\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:introduction}

\subsection{Motivation}
% [Member B] Describe why MLOps is important in modern software systems.
% Explain the problem space: the gap between ML development and production deployment.

Machine learning models deliver value only when they run reliably in production.
The discipline of \emph{MLOps}---combining machine learning, software engineering,
and DevOps principles---addresses the full lifecycle: from data ingestion and
model training to deployment, monitoring, and retraining~\cite{sculley2015hidden}.

\subsection{Scope of This Report}
% [Member B] Define clearly what the report covers and what it does not.

This report presents the architecture of an MLOps platform designed for
mid-scale organisations.
It covers:
\begin{itemize}
  \item the core MLOps concepts and their relevance to software architecture
        (\Cref{sec:mlops-concepts});
  \item the design decisions and their rationale (\Cref{sec:design-rationale});
  \item a balanced analysis of the chosen architecture (\Cref{sec:pros-cons});
  \item the layered architectural model (\Cref{sec:layered-architecture}); and
  \item conclusions and future directions (\Cref{sec:conclusion}).
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Report Structure}
% [Member B] Brief one-paragraph road-map of the document.

\Cref{sec:mlops-concepts} surveys the key concepts.
\Cref{sec:design-rationale} explains the choices made.
\Cref{sec:pros-cons} weighs benefits against limitations.
\Cref{sec:layered-architecture} presents the full layered model.
\Cref{sec:conclusion} closes with findings and next steps.
